scientific_integrity: The all-order theorem follows from a Fourier cosine-gap lemma, exact contact matrices and finite-group positivity. Small-order floating-point verification only corroborates those analytic arguments. The claim does not establish global bibliographic novelty or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the seven-point root-hexagonal support on square finite tori; older toroidal graph spectra and continuous hexagon literature remain potential equivalence risks; the primary text of two plausible historical sources was inaccessible.
title: Exact hexagonal Turán masses and optimizer-face rigidity on finite square tori
